purpose: Top-level rendering/style baseline for the original neutral and every derived character variant. This rule outranks cowlick-only rules.

sourceOfTruth.comparisonRule: Always compare the baseline directly to each variant. Never inherit style from one variant to the next.

drawingModel.thickLineConstruction: Do NOT switch to a digitally thicker brush. Build visually thicker/darker contours by laying 3-4 or more nearby repeated strokes with the same base stroke width.
drawingModel.darkAreaConstruction: Increase density through repeated directional strokes/hatching, not solid digital fill.
drawingModel.contourRule: Major silhouettes may look thick only because multiple slightly offset fine strokes overlap.
drawingModel.roughnessRule: Allow small human inconsistencies, imperfect overlap, wobble, and retracing. Avoid clean vector-like single contours.
drawingModel.lineDensityRule: Hair, clothing edges, boots, stool and emphasized contours should preserve the multi-stroke hand-drawn density of the baseline.

immutableStyleRequirements: visual thickness created by repeated fine strokes rather than one thick stroke
multiple retraced contour lines where emphasis is needed
no solid black fill used as a substitute for line density
retain the baseline's hand-drawn wobble and uneven spacing
variantNormalizationPriority: 2. preserve camera, identity, proportions and silhouette relationship to baseline
3. normalize line-construction method to baseline repeated-fine-stroke style
4. normalize hair/cowlick to the locked crown reference for the applicable angle
5. reject any candidate that achieves similarity by redrawing the whole figure

masterRuleDependency.relationship: This style spec specializes line/style rules for this workspace and must be applied under the master rule.
